mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite sustained GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4% triggers a tightening cycle, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX shows positive 20d returns despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4%, or IC > 0.05 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% in a late-cycle expansion signals labor market strength, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite UNRATE falling below 6%, or IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) reflects robust supply-side growth, enhancing corporate earnings and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite sustained INDPRO growth, or IC < 0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 7 million indicates a strong labor market, driving corporate profits and investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite PAYEMS crossing above 7M, or IC > 0.04 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals robust demand and supply-side growth, amplifying corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite simultaneous GDPC1 and INDPRO increases, or IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly demand for final goods (RSAFS) below 400 million indicates weakening consumption, but in a post-shock recovery context, this signals improved underlying demand trends, fostering positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite RSAFS falling below 400M in a post-shock recovery period, or IC > 0.05 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) below trend signals cooling price pressures, reducing risk premiums and enhancing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite sustained CPIAUCSL decline, or IC < 0.04 over 3-year window.
